lines.text: My weekend plan is basic: pizza and a movie.

data.define: Describes things that are very ordinary and popular. It can sound a bit mean.

example.text: My weekend plan is basic: pizza and a movie.

misuse.text: Don't call your friend's gift 'basic' to her.

data.l1_hook: Lại pizza với phim nữa hả?
data.l1_ex: Kế hoạch cuối tuần của tui basic lắm: pizza với phim.

native.tip: “basic” = Quá bình thường, đại trà. Ví dụ: “My weekend plan is basic: pizza and a movie.”
native.caption:
